work.description: CCLXXIII De Dominici gregis: entire thirteen-clause Guastalla erection constitution fully read. Complete earlier abbatial and civic history, cathedral erection, five dignities, sixteen canons, seven mansionaries and two praebendaries, full mensa and seminary endowments, house and vicar provision, every Reggiolo/Luzzara and other territorial transfer, immediate subjection, tax, Sanvitale execution/subdelegation and archive rules, validation, derogation, transumpt, sanctio and datum LF54264–54267 retained. Exact XML leaves409–411 ordinary substantive left/right flow; no joined or reversed body blocks. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
work.title: Erectio episcopatus Guastallensis et constitutio cathedralis ac dioecesis
